name: m1k3
description: Give Claude your private, on-device memory, documents and voice, through the M1K3 app on this Mac.
long_description:
M1K3 is a free, private AI assistant that runs on your Mac. This extension connects Claude to the M1K3 app you already have running: Claude can search your documents and notes, save and recall memories, ask M1K3's local brain, and speak aloud in M1K3's voice.

It needs the M1K3 app (free on the Mac App Store) open, with Settings > Server > MCP server switched on, and the access token from that screen.

What leaves your Mac: this extension talks only to M1K3 on this Mac. But whatever a tool returns to Claude (a memory, a document excerpt, a transcript) becomes part of your conversation with Claude, like anything else you share with it. M1K3 serves one connected client at a time.

access_token.title: M1K3 access token
access_token.description: In M1K3, open Settings > Server and copy the access token. It stays on this Mac.

port.title: Port
port.description: The port M1K3's MCP server listens on. Leave it at 4242 unless you changed it in M1K3.

tools.name: search_knowledge
tools.description: Search your documents and notes in M1K3.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Save a fact to M1K3's memory.

tools.name: related_memory
tools.description: Find memories linked to one you name.

tools.name: ask_m1k3
tools.description: Ask M1K3's local brain a question, grounded in your knowledge.

tools.name: get_answer
tools.description: Fetch the answer to a question that was still running.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: List recent questions put to M1K3.

tools.name: ask_private_cloud
tools.description: Ask Apple's Private Cloud Compute through M1K3 (off unless you switch it on).

tools.name: speak
tools.description: Say something aloud in M1K3's voice.

tools.name: listen
tools.description: Listen on M1K3's microphone and return what was said.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: See what M1K3 is doing right now.

tools.name: propose_todo
tools.description: Propose a todo for you to accept or dismiss.

tools.name: open_link
tools.description: Open a web link in M1K3's side panel.
